The mark "3" has no matching mark in the text. The note "Quoad directionem..." has no mark in the text and is placed beside "non quoad coactionem"; its position is approximate. Doubtful readings: "subentur", "seruiri", "seiunctim" (the printed word is hard to read), "mirer?" (the punctuation may be a colon), "yir" (catchword, uncertain). Long s printed as f has been transcribed as s. The main text is set in italic and the running head is taken from the printed header.
